source_metadata.exact_title: Human-to-Dog Transmission of Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus
source_metadata.source_type: journal dispatch / household case report with outbreak context

findings: Transmission direction and the source of nurse reinfection remain author inference, not demonstrated causality.
Vitek 2 susceptibility was discordant with Etest/PBP2/mecA results; the atom set preserves the separate methods rather than reconciling them.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated case-report relationship/transmission-direction model; transmission is retained as author_conclusion text.
Treatment response in a three-member household is represented as qualitative_result because the source provides no comparative effect estimate.
extraction_limitations: Bibliography entries were excluded from evidence atoms and exported separately as a task queue.
No figures, tables, algorithms, appendices, or supplements are present in the target PDF.
The source is a household case report; its strain concordance cannot prove transmission direction or treatment efficacy.
